_: THE ROSTER OF OFFICERS — who can be signed on, world-wide.
_why: 0015 authored EIGHT, which was right for a twelve-port world. There are 224 harbours now, and the owner has asked for an Inn where captains APPEAR — weighted to their own nation, then their region, then their culture. Eight people cannot fill 224 inns: nearly every one would be empty, and the building would read as broken rather than as rare.
_shape: Each carries the specialty, what they are worth, their wage, the nation they belong to and the port they call home. The Inn derives who is present from (port, day, world secret) — never rolled and stored, so refreshing cannot re-roll them.
_ranks: There are no S/A/B/C ranks here. That ladder is DESIGN_V1 §7.1 and its own slice; these are officers in the shape 0015 defined, and a rank column can be added to the same rows without moving them.
